items.title: Overseas Exhibition Support
items.desc: We support Korean companies through every step of exhibiting overseas — booth rental, stand construction, logistics and exhibition marketing — plus links to government support programs and national pavilion organization, all tailored to you.

items.title: Buyer Sourcing & Matching
items.desc: Systematic, ongoing export support for exhibitors and export-marketing participants, from buyer sourcing and matching to market research and export contracts.

items.title: SME Export Marketing
items.desc: Marketing that strengthens the global competitiveness of SMEs, including the digital transformation (DX) of export operations through online channels.

items.title: Business Event Planning & Operation
items.desc: End-to-end support for conferences, roadshows, seminars and corporate events for government bodies and companies in Korea and abroad — from planning and operation to follow-up. *Partnered with specialist Korean agencies when needed.

items.title: Trade Agency
items.desc: Systematic, ongoing export services for exhibitors and export-marketing participants, from buyer sourcing and matching to market research and export contracts. *DX of export operations through online channels is planned.
